reviews.text:
The serum has a gel-like texture that melts into the skin upon application. It can leave a slightly sticky finish, but that doesn’t bother me, and it works really well under makeup.

The serum has a wonderful formula designed to brighten the skin and even out the skin tone.

I use it in my morning skincare routine, and I can genuinely see results. It’s not the kind of product that delivers visible results overnight, but with consistent use, you can definitely notice a difference.
reviews.zh:
呢款精華有凝膠質地，塗上去會溶入皮膚。可能會留低少少黏膩嘅效果，但係我唔介意，而且化妝底下都好好用。

呢款精華嘅配方好好，旨在提亮膚色、均勻膚色。

我喺朝早護膚程序入面用，我真係見到效果。佢唔係隔夜見效嘅產品，但係持續使用，你一定會見到分別。

reviews.text: I finished the whole jar and really enjoyed using this. It gives my skin such a beautiful glow and feels like an instant burst of hydration. One of my favorite things about it is how well makeup sits over it — my base looks smoother and more fresh instead of dry. I especially love this during winter when my skin needs that extra hydration. 💦🩷
reviews.zh: 我已經用完成罐，真係好享受用呢款。佢令皮膚有好靚嘅光澤，好似即時補咗一大陣水分咁。我最鍾意嘅其中一點，係化妝疊喺上面都好好——底妝睇落更加順滑、清新，唔會乾。我特別鍾意冬天用，嗰時我皮膚需要額外嘅水分。💦🩷

reviews.text: I have oily, but dehydrated skin and I use tretinoin everyday. I thought this would be a lovely addition to my daytime routine as a hydrating serum, but I think the niacinamide in it just didn't work out for me. My skin felt too dry because of it. If it wasn't for tret, I'd be using this everyday. It's an amazing product. It feels good to put on, it's not tacky and it never broke me out. I can handle niacinamide too, just not when I'm using tret aswell. But if you're not on tret THIS IS GREAT!
reviews.zh: 我皮膚油但缺水，而且我每日都用 tretinoin（維 A 酸）。我以為呢款可以作為補水精華，好好加入我嘅日間護膚程序，但係我覺得佢入面嘅煙酰胺就唔啱我。因為呢個，我皮膚感覺太乾。如果唔係因為 tret，我每日都會用呢款。佢係一款好好嘅產品，塗上去感覺好舒服，唔會黏，而且從來冇令我爆痘。我都可以接受煙酰胺，只係同時用緊 tret 就唔得。但係如果你冇用 tret，呢款就好好！

reviews.text: I’ve been using the Arencia Holy Hyssop Serum 30 for a few weeks, and I’m genuinely impressed. The jelly-like texture feels unique and melts into the skin without leaving a sticky residue. It absorbs quickly and provides long-lasting hydration. I highly recommend this serum to anyone looking for deep hydration, radiance, and a gentle brightening effect. I would definitely repurchase it.
reviews.zh: 我用咗 Arencia Holy Hyssop Serum 30 幾個星期，真係好滿意。佢嘅果凍狀質地好獨特，溶入皮膚，唔會留低黏膩嘅殘留。吸收快，補水效果持久。我非常推薦呢款精華畀所有想搵深層補水、透亮光澤同溫和提亮效果嘅人。我一定會再買。

reviews.text:
The Arencia Holy Hyssop Serum feels lightweight and hydrating on my skin. It absorbs quickly without any sticky feeling and helps keep my skin looking fresh and healthy. I love using it at night, especially when my skin really needs some pampering and extra care. It makes my skin feel calmer, softer, and well-hydrated by the next morning. It also layers well with the rest of my skincare routine and works great for my sensitive, acne-prone skin without causing irritation or breakouts.

my 2nd pack now
reviews.zh:
Arencia Holy Hyssop Serum 塗喺我皮膚上好輕盈、補水。吸收快，冇任何黏膩感，有助皮膚保持清新、健康嘅樣子。我好鍾意晚上用，特別係皮膚真係需要一啲呵護同額外護理嗰時。到翌日朝早，佢令皮膚感覺更加平靜、柔軟、水潤。同護膚程序嘅其他產品疊用都好好，對我敏感、易生暗瘡嘅皮膚都好好，冇引起刺激或者爆痘。

而家係我嘅第二包

reviews.text: I love its colour and its gel consistency, absorbs well on skin and help with calming skin and gives you a glow. I am continuing to use it to see more changes it bring to my skin. currently I’m loving it and using daily on my pm routine. I really want to try more from the brand. they got other variants of this serum. they play with textures.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意佢嘅顏色同凝膠質地，喺皮膚上吸收得好，可以幫助平靜皮膚，亦都帶嚟光澤。我繼續用緊，睇吓會為我嘅皮膚帶嚟更多改變。而家我好鍾意，每晚護膚都用。我真係好想試吓呢個品牌嘅其他產品。佢哋仲有呢款精華嘅其他版本，佢哋喺質地上都有變化。

reviews.text: My favorite step of the night routine. After applying I wake up with the most glowing skin and you only need to apply a small amount so it will last for about 3 months (depends on how frequently you use it or if it’s twice a day or only nights) I recommend it if you have red post pimple/acne spots and if you’re looking for a glowing skin when waking up
reviews.zh: 係我晚上護膚程序入面最鍾意嘅一步。塗完之後，我醒嚟嗰時皮膚最有光澤，而且只需要塗少少，所以可以用大約三個月（視乎你幾常用，或者係咪每日兩次，定係淨係晚上用）。如果你有紅色嘅暗瘡後留低嘅印，又或者你想醒嚟嗰時有光澤嘅皮膚，我推薦。

reviews.text: I’ve been using the Arencia Holy Hyssop Serum 30 and I’m thoroughly impressed. Its lightweight, non-greasy texture absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling plump and refreshed. The combination of hyssop extract and niacinamide has noticeably brightened my complexion and evened out my skin tone. I’ve also observed a reduction in fine lines and improved skin elasticity. It’s gentle enough for daily use and has become a staple in my skincare routine. Highly satisfied and would recommend it to anyone seeking a radiant, healthy glow.
reviews.zh: 我一直用緊 Arencia Holy Hyssop Serum 30，真係好深刻。佢輕盈、唔油膩嘅質地吸收得好快，令皮膚感覺飽滿、清爽。牛膝草萃取同煙酰胺嘅組合，令我嘅膚色明顯亮咗，膚色亦都更加均勻。我亦留意到細紋減少咗，皮膚彈性都改善咗。佢夠溫和，可以日常使用，已經成為我護膚程序入面必備嘅產品。非常滿意，會推薦畀所有想要光采、健康光澤嘅人。
